component.name: FujiNet Go Astrocade
component.summary: Self-contained Bally Astrocade with built-in FujiNet

description.p: A Bally Astrocade with FujiNet built in: boots straight into FujiNet's config client, with a clickable keypad window standing in for the console's 24-key keypad so every key can be driven with a mouse.

Emulation is a MAME-derived Astrocade core (the Z80 CPU, the data-chip video with its magic function generator, and the custom I/O sound chip), with FujiNet attached over Bus-Over-IP (BoIP) on loopback TCP.
First release: the emulator core (validated pixel-exact against MAME) and its FujiNet cartridge, the GNOME frontend with the keypad window, and system-ROM import.
